recommended_tuning_summary: Region: Route production West Coast users to nearest low-latency region (us-west1) for low egress but test us-east1/us-central to compare p95 — Console shows region delta
Timeouts: bump client-side request timeout from 5s -> 10s for streaming; set streaming chunk timeout to 1s to show partial content earlier
Prompt length: move static system prompts to server pinning or short identifiers; trim few-shot examples, prefer retrieval-based context to stay under 800 tokens
Model selection: try hosted low-latency variant for p95 measurement; fallback to higher-quality for complex queries
SDK: add explicit retry/backoff so retries don't mask original latency; instrument request_ids and share traces
Batching/caching: enable prefix/KV caching for repeated user context; aggressive caching reduced token count in PoC by ~30%
Monitoring: enable per-route p50/p95 in Console and alert when p95 > 700ms; share console link in workshop
